descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator puts you in the captain's seat over real cities. Amsterdam is included; New York, Paris and London are city packs you add from the LOCATIONS menu.

THE REAL AMSTERDAM - INCLUDED
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the canal ring, Centraal, the Dam, the Rijksmuseum, the A'DAM Tower, the ArenA, IJmuiden and Zandvoort. Schiphol with all six runways, Lelystad, hundreds of turning windmills, the tulip fields and the North Sea.

LOCATIONS - CITY PACKS
One-time purchases, downloaded once, yours to keep:
NEW YORK - Manhattan, the Empire State, One World Trade, the Statue of Liberty, eleven bridges, JFK, LaGuardia, Newark, Teterboro.
PARIS - through the legs of the Eiffel Tower, the Seine and 29 bridges, Notre-Dame, the Louvre, Versailles, CDG, Orly, Le Bourget.
LONDON - through Tower Bridge, Big Ben, the Shard, Canary Wharf, Wembley, Windsor, Heathrow, London City, Gatwick.
Every city has its own hangar, eleven missions, airports, trains, boats and night lights.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter whose canopy closes down over you as you throttle up for takeoff.

A STEADY COCKPIT AT ANY ALTITUDE
Rock-steady at cruise altitude; inside a cloud the white fills only your windows.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL, A GLASS HANGAR, ONLINE CO-OP
Taxi and landing clearances. Walk around, repaint and wash your aircraft. Quick Match or a private sky with a code.

ENGLISH AND DUTCH menus.
